_readme: EXAMPLE config for the 'Great Cretaceous' practice pod (lab mirror on 192.168.100.0/24).
At competition: copy this file to config/ccdc.json and change the subnet/IPs to match the team packet.
config/ccdc.json is in .gitignore so competition-day values are never committed.
NEVER put passwords in this file. Scored ports below are EDUCATED GUESSES - confirm against the packet / scoreboard.
scoredAccounts = accounts the scoring engine logs in with. Rotation scripts auto-exclude them (you need a Password Change Request first).

hosts.name: pangea
hosts.notes: Gateway for the whole pod. Breaking routing breaks EVERY scored service.

hosts.name: trex
hosts.notes: Keycloak on hellcreek likely binds to LDAP here with a service account - do not break that account.

hosts.name: fossil
hosts.notes: Scoring engine probably logs in over RDP/SSH with a domain or local user.

hosts.name: fernbank
hosts.notes: Databases live on hatchery. DB password changes there must be mirrored in wp-config.php and LocalSettings.php.

hosts.name: laboratory
hosts.notes: IP not in the practice packet - fill in. Check for CI runners, git servers, docker.

hosts.name: hatchery
hosts.notes: MySQL must stay reachable from fernbank (do NOT bind to 127.0.0.1).

hosts.name: hellcreek
hosts.notes: Federation bind account lives in AD on trex.

hosts.name: badlands
hosts.notes: IP not in the practice packet - fill in. SELinux is on by default on Fedora.

hosts.name: tarpit
hosts.notes: Our own log sink. Graylog depends on MongoDB + OpenSearch/Elasticsearch running locally.
